MaterialSupportCategoryEnumeration.description: This Property provides information about the category of the material support system.

None.description: The machine has no material support system, the material must be fed in accordingly.

Fixed_Machine_Table.description: The material support system is a fixed machine table.

Sliding_Machine_Table.description: The material support system is a sliding machine table.

Carousel.description: The material support system is a carousel.

Conveyor_Belt.description: The material support system is a conveyor belt.

Turntable_90Degrees.description: The material support system is a turntable, which can rotate 90 degrees.
